entities.name: William Gordon Lennox
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Gordon Lennox was an American neurologist and epileptologist who was a pioneer in the use of electroencephalography (EEG) for the diagnosis and treatment of epilepsy. He graduated from Colorado College and Harvard Medical School.
